description: Provenance of every committed file under data/raw/. sha256 is of the committed CSV. Regenerate with `make refresh`.

aurora/stats_lines_daily.csv.notes: Blockscout stats-service lines (resolution=DAY). txnsFee is in ETH (Aurora's gas token). Rows flagged is_approximate (the current day) are dropped in processing.

coingecko/market_chart_365d.csv.notes: Keyless /coins/<id>/market_chart?days=365&interval=daily. Points are 00:00 UTC except the last one, which is the live price at fetch time (dropped in processing).

defillama/chain_fees_daily.csv.notes: summary/fees/<chain> for the chain protocol itself (gas/transaction fees paid to the chain). dailyRevenue = DefiLlama's revenue definition for that chain (e.g. burned fees). NEAR series sourced by DefiLlama from Allium.

defillama/chain_tvl_daily.csv.notes: historicalChainTvl per chain; DefiLlama default TVL (excludes liquid staking, double counts and borrowed by default).

defillama/chains_snapshot.csv.notes: Current TVL of every chain tracked by DefiLlama (for rank context).

defillama/coin_prices_daily.csv.notes: coins.llama.fi/chart, period=1d, paged in 400-day spans. Timestamps are the provider's sample times (not always 00:00 UTC); one or more rows per UTC date.

defillama/coin_prices_intents_days.csv.notes: DefiLlama historical prices for the CoinGecko ids of the 1Click token list, at noon UTC of each sampled day.

defillama/dex_volume_daily.csv.notes: overview/dexs/<chain> totalDataChart. For NEAR this INCLUDES NEAR Intents (see dex_volume_near_by_protocol_daily).

defillama/dex_volume_near_by_protocol_da.notes: totalDataChartBreakdown of overview/dexs/near: daily volume per protocol on NEAR.

defillama/near_intents_daily.csv.notes: NEAR Intents via DefiLlama. Upstream is a NEAR-uploaded Dune dataset (dimension-adapters dexs/near-intents): single-sourced, grade B.

defillama/stablecoins_daily.csv.notes: stablecoincharts/<chain>: sum over peg types of totalCirculatingUSD.

fastnear_api/treasury_holdings_current.c.notes: FastNear indexed FT / NFT / staking-pool holdings of tracked wallets. balance_raw is in the token's smallest unit (decimals not resolved).

fastnear_tx/block_sample_blocks.csv.notes: One row per sampled block (including empty blocks).

fastnear_tx/block_sample_extra_blocks.cs.notes: Phase 2a widening of the stratified block sample for recent months (independent seed stream; pooled with block_sample_blocks.csv in the analysis).

fastnear_tx/block_sample_extra_txs.csv.notes: Every transaction of every extra sampled block. Public on-chain account IDs.

fastnear_tx/block_sample_txs.csv.notes: Every transaction of every sampled block. Public on-chain account IDs.

fastnear_tx/intents_control_txs.csv.notes: Control sample: every transaction in which intents.near receives a receipt, in a few short windows per day; whether it has token_diff legs and whether the fee collector appears in its logs (tests that the fee-paying frame contains all swaps).

fastnear_tx/intents_days.csv.notes: Sampled UTC days: height range, census counts (fee-paying txs = txs whose event logs name the fee collector), protocol fee in pips at both ends.

fastnear_tx/intents_swap_legs.csv.notes: One row per token leg of every DIP-4 token_diff event of the sampled transactions (tx_no -> intents_swap_txs.csv; amount signed, raw units; fee_collected = protocol fee charged on that token in that event).

fastnear_tx/intents_swap_txs.csv.notes: Every sampled fee-paying transaction: window, hash, block height, number of token_diff legs (0 = it paid a fee without a successful token_diff of intents.near).

fastnear_tx/intents_windows.csv.notes: Sampled windows of consecutive blocks per day: start height, length, number of fee-paying transactions listed and fetched.

fastnear_tx/month_boundaries.csv.notes: First block whose timestamp is >= the boundary (00:00 UTC on the 1st of each month; the last row is 00:00 UTC of the fetch day and closes the final, partial month).

fastnear_tx/monthly_receiver_counts.csv.notes: txs_count = number of transactions in the month whose real receiver (relayer unwrapped) is the account. Exact count from the FastNear ClickHouse index.

fastnear_tx/receiver_txs_alltime.csv.notes: All-time count of transactions whose real receiver is the account (relayers excluded).

fastnear_tx/signer_lifetime.csv.notes: First appearance in any role (creation / first funding) for every drawn signer; last really-signed transaction and lifetime signed count only for signers new in their drawn month (cohort retention). Lifetime counts are as of the fetch.

fastnear_tx/signer_month_activity.csv.notes: Per drawn (signer, month): exact count of transactions really signed in the month (is_real_signer, relayers unwrapped) and the unix-second timestamps of up to 200 of them (the most recent), delta-encoded: ts_first_s = earliest returned, ts_gaps_s = space-separated gaps in seconds, ascending.

fastnear_tx/signer_tx_details.csv.notes: Receiver, real receiver (inside Delegate actions), FunctionCall method names and action kinds of up to 20 recent txs per detailed (signer, month).

fastnear_tx/trail_hops.csv.notes: Outflows of accounts that received >= min_near NEAR from treasury.near since trail_from, followed hop by hop; stop_reason says where and why a trail ends.

fastnear_tx/wallet_flows.csv.notes: One row per value movement touching a tracked wallet (NEAR deposits of successful action receipts excluding gas refunds; NEP-141, NEP-245 and DIP-4 token_diff events). amount_raw in the asset's smallest unit (NEAR: yocto).

github/contributor_weeks.csv.notes: Weekly commits (default branch) of the top 100 contributors per repo, weeks with >0 commits only. Public GitHub logins.

github/fetch_log.csv.notes: Every GitHub URL requested and its final HTTP status (202 = statistics still being computed by GitHub; such tables are missing for that repo).

github/participation.csv.notes: Weekly commit counts of all contributors, last 52 weeks (bucket 0 = most recent).

github/releases.csv.notes: Up to 200 most recent releases per repo.

github/repos.csv.notes: Repository metadata at fetch time. nearai repos = most-starred non-fork, non-archived repos pushed in the last 365 days.

governance/hsp029_status.csv.notes: HSP-029 proposal metadata from the NEAR governance forum at fetch time (status field of the proposal frontmatter, cap formula, activation rule).

nearblocks/charts_daily.csv.notes: Verbatim /v1/charts rows (all values kept as strings; supply and fee fields are yoctoNEAR). date truncated to YYYY-MM-DD (UTC day). Data by NearBlocks (attribution required by their free plan).

nearblocks/stats_snapshot.csv.notes: Current network snapshot (/v1/stats). Not a time series; changes every refresh.

oneclick/tokens.csv.notes: Public 1Click token list (no JWT needed for this endpoint): asset id, decimals, symbol, CoinGecko id. Current prices in the response are not kept.

opendevdata/eco_mads_monthly.csv.notes: Electric Capital Open Dev Data eco_mads: last available day of each month per ecosystem (all_devs etc. are 28-day rolling Monthly Active Developer counts), plus the sum of the daily num_commits column over the month. Read with HTTP range requests (no full download).

rpc/final_block_header.csv.notes: Header of the final block at refresh time.

rpc/genesis_config.csv.notes: Scalar fields of the mainnet genesis config.

rpc/protocol_config_latest.csv.notes: Scalar fields of the protocol config at the final block of the refresh.

rpc/sputnik_dao_list.csv.notes: All DAOs created by the Sputnik DAO v2 factory.

rpc/treasury_accounts_current.csv.notes: Liquid (amount) and staked-locked balances of tracked wallets.

rpc/validators_current.csv.notes: current_validators of the epoch in progress at refresh time.

rpc_archival/epoch_validator_stakes.csv.notes: current_validators stake of every sampled epoch (raw validators responses are ~0.4 MB each and are not committed; this table keeps account_id and stake only).

rpc_archival/epochs_sampled.csv.notes: One fully characterized epoch per sample (see module docstring for the identities). yoctoNEAR integers stored as strings. validators_available=false: archival nodes answer UNKNOWN_EPOCH before epoch 545 (~2021-03), so epoch boundaries were found by bisection on block-header epoch_id and stake fields are empty. Fallback host: archival-rpc.mainnet.near.org.

rpc_archival/intents_fee_collector_balan.notes: Fee collector NEP-245 balances inside intents.near at the first block of the day and of the next day (raw token units).

rpc_archival/treasury_monthly.csv.notes: Balances at the first block of each month (from fastnear_tx/month_boundaries.csv). exists=false: account not yet created at that height.
